description.ru:
Миньская республика, поделена между собой враждующими армиями милитаристов, на дворе гражданская война. В это время на небосклоне оперной труппы «Грушевый сад» восходит новая звезда – актер Чэнь Ци Мин. Но вот незадача, на него положил глаз недавно прибывший маршал Янь Цы – внебрачный сын крупного милитариста с севера и его русской любовницы. Поддержка и опасность, идущие рука об руку, когда имеешь дело с военными шишками; козни и уловки, без которых не обходится мир театра; проходя через все испытания, Чэнь Ци Мин открывает для себя иную сторону маршала Яня, спрятанную глубоко под мундиром. Кто бы мог подумать, что нить судьбы, связывающая их, берёт своё начало ещё в далёком детстве.  
  
примечание: Западный флигель - это отсылка к одноимённой классической драме, повествующий о свободной любви, идущей против косных феодальных порядков.

For centuries the Lee and Dai had shared a deep bond in the form of a master-servant relationship which gradually evolved into a strong friendship between the heirs of both families. Therefore true to tradition Dai Xiaodao (aka Dai Xiaoshuang) decides to assume the role of the manservant for Li Qingri (aka childhood friend) in place of her dead brother, Dai Dadao.   
  
To her chagrin, pretending to be a boy was but the tip of the iceberg in terms of the list of challenges that would come her way. On top of having to contain her secret love for Li Qingri who has become her roommate… what's the deal with that sinister-looking senpai (who's always flashing some fish at her) and that sweet-looking female classmate (who's really a carnivore in herbivore's clothing)!   
  
All that aside, what was that mysteriously beautiful scent that Dai Xiaodao got a whiff of when she bumped into the notorious Ye Weien at that secret path? Surely, no matter what the legend says, that obnoxious playboy could not be the man of her destiny!

description.en:
Warm and comforting like the stars in the Big Dipper
The crimson clouds burst and surge ahead
Compressing the soundless air of the universe
Massless subatomic particles quickly shift their atoms
The crimson gradually extends into a circle
Fatigue settles into the mind and body
Before the mind awakens and tremors violently
Once again grappling with collapse
At this moment, we gaze at each other and smile
Only time can balance the consciousness of the universe
Converging into a star in the sky
The aluminium shell no longer has any significance.
Yet I gaze longingly at the distant blue blazing galaxy
Descend then
In this temporary form of mine.

Nếu là bảy vị nữ chính đều hắc hóa, thế giới liền sẽ diệt vong. Cho nên ta muốn dùng tình yêu đến cảm hóa các nàng!
description.zh: 我穿书了，成为了《天元大陆之唯我独尊》又名《我的七个老婆是大反派》这本书里的三天就要死的反派男炮灰，带系统，任务是拯救世界。要是七位女主的都黑化了，世界就会灭亡。 所以要用爱来感化她们！

description.en:
Sijila was once the most adorable mythical creature in the world. Its overwhelming cuteness earned it the reverence of humanity, granting it a carefree life of plenty. However, as people became preoccupied with admiring Sijila's charm and stopped being productive, coupled with Sikila's ever-growing appetite, it soon consumed all the world's resources.

The gods could no longer tolerate its behavior. They stripped Sijila of all its "cuteness power," turning it into a ridiculed ball of flesh. They transformed a mere fraction of its "cuteness power" into a group of little Corgis, tasked with helping it atone for its sins.

Ye Chen, a second-year student at Shen Jiang University, lost his memory in a car accident and at the same time is suspected by the police of being a murderer in a new case. 

Surprisingly, the place where the murder took place is exactly the same as a scene that appeared in his dreams. As the investigation progresses, Ye Chen discovers that his life is shrouded in a fog, and that it all seems to be connected to his lost memories ...
description.zh: 申江大学二年级学生叶宸因车祸失去了记忆，又在不知情的状况下被警察怀疑为一起案件的凶手，令人惊讶的是发生凶案的地方竟然和他梦里出现过的场景一模一样。随着调查的深入，叶宸发现自己的生活被笼罩了一层迷雾，而这一切似乎和自己失去的记忆有所关联……

description.en: The possessive 'vinegar jar' top Ren Hong and the attention-seeking yet fearful of attention bottom Xie Yiwen, who are childhood friends, have a strong mutual crush. However, due to a confession before entering college, they created a rift. A year later, the two coincidentally joined the school's nearly disbanded drama club, which became an opportunity for them to gradually understand their true feelings and learn how to love!
Each chapter is a short horrible story. They are close to your life, but imaginative. Which can help you banish boredom and generate� excitement.

What first starts as a night of drunken passion quickly spirals into unexpected love, as together they begin to search for meaning in a world that has all but deserted them…
description.pl: Na ponurych przedmieściach Nowego Jorku, pewna skazana na prostytucję piękność z południa, Sunny, spotyka studenta Lou, który zarabia przepijając innych ludzi. Co na początku uchodzi za jedno-nocną, pijacką przygodę, nagle przeradza się w miłość. Obydwoje zaczynają szukać sensu tego świata, który potrafił ich tylko porzucić…

description.en: The story is set in the sixteenth year of the Jiading era during the Southern Song dynasty. Shen Mo, a modern undercover detective travelling to the past, begins his ambition to manipulate and bend the empire to his will. Armed with countless schemings and trickery, he uses his modern detective skills to crack many strange cases in Southern Song, as well as his mastery in espionage to torment the secret agents from the kingdoms of Liao and Jin. And when the threatening conquests of the invincible Mongolian cavalry begin to draw near, he trains an army made of steel to smash their sweeping invasion! To single-handedly dominate the world and fight against the odds, this is the epic war of a man versus an era!

Герой нашей истории, Хуан Эр – студент-первокурсник престижной военной академии – не хочет повторить жизненный путь отца, влачившего заурядную жизнь в глухой провинции. Having left Hua Yuan Shan (literally, “Chinese Plain Mountain,” presumably a sword school) to attend a martial arts congress, Xin Moyi and Xu Xuan soon make acquaintance with Yue Ling Long, a young girl from Moyue Shan (literally, “Devil Moon Mountain”). But then her friend Zhi Nian became the first “victim” in the exchange of power in the land of Shu! At this moment, Xue Tao had an opportunity: with her skill and poetry as bargaining chips, she won the esteem of the new military governor Wei Gao.

From then on, she officially entered the power core of the land of Shu, facing the forces from all sides that were making waves… However, as she cautiously went through a series of power conflicts, what awaited her in the end was the difficult decision between 'survive' and 'truth'...
